name: Homarr
description: Homarr is a dashboard for organizing and accessing all your apps from one place. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Homarr as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Dashboard for organizing self-hosted apps. Deploy Homarr with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
